newsitem.title: USA: John F. Kennedy Jr. weds girlfriend - media reports.
newsitem.headline: John F. Kennedy Jr. weds girlfriend - media reports.

text.p: John F. Kennedy Jr., son of the assassinated U.S. president and once declared "the sexiest man alive," renounced his claim as the world's most eligible bachelor by marrying girlfriend Carolyn Bessette in a highly secretive wedding, media reports said on Sunday.

Jacksonville, Florida television station WTLV, an NBC affiliate, said that Rhode Island Representative Patrick Kennedy had confirmed the media reports that Kennedy, 35, wed Bessette on Saturday on remote Cumberland Island off the Georgia coast.

Kennedy's image as a young boy was indelibly etched in the American consciousness when he saluted the flag-draped coffin of his father, President John F. Kennedy, during the funeral following Kennedy's November 1963 assassination in Dallas.
WTLV reported that Kennedy and Bessette exchanged vows at a small chapel at the north end of the island and celebrated the event at a private party under tents.
The station said JFK Jr.'s uncle, Massachusetts Sen. Ted Kennedy, his sister, Caroline Kennedy, and William Kennedy Smith were among those in attendance.
It said Sen. Kennedy declined comment on Sunday when asked whether his nephew had married, but said the family had a "great" weekend on the island.
Earl Moore, chief of staff for Representative Joe Kennedy, a Massachusetts Democrat, said he knew nothing about a wedding and the congressman was in his home state through the weekend.

The Florida Times-Union reported that security was unusually high on the island, a resort playground of pristine beaches and wilderness accessible by ferry from St. Mary's, Georgia, just north of the state's border with Florida.
The newspaper said security guards turned away curiousity-seekers and the north end of the island was closed to the public late on Saturday afternoon.
WTLV reported that members of the Kennedy family stayed at the Greyfield Inn, a secluded bed and breakfast which apparently hosted the reception following the service.

The station said that a manager of a Fernandina Beach, Florida restaurant that catered the event said her staff told her that Kennedy and Bessette were married. Contacted on Sunday, another manager at the restaurant said "I cannot confirm or deny" the report.

The Times-Union, citing an unnamed source, reported that the Greyfield Inn had no guests all week but was preparing for a big weekend event. It also reported that friends of Greyfield employees said the staff had undergone Secret Service checks because they were told Hillary Clinton would attend the event.
Bessette and Kennedy, longtime companions, had a screaming confrontation in New York's Central Park early this year which was videotaped and photographed.
Kennedy, publisher of the political magazine George and Bessette, a publicist for designer Calvin Klein, had lived together for a year at the time.
Before that he had a widely publicised, on-and-off relationship for several years with actress Darryl Hannah.
During the 1980s after graduating from New York University law school he worked briefly in the Manhattan District Attorney's office after passing the New York Bar after several attempts.
He started the high-profile magazine after leaving his job in the prosecutor's office. Kennedy was named by "People" magazine as its "sexiest man alive" in a yearly feature.
